verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents opening custom ports through docker -p arguments in the image config and filtering offers by direct_port_count. It also auto-creates a secure Cloudflare tunnel for each open port, and supports SSH port forwarding. For private networking, it documents overlay networks that give instances a shared private virtual LAN, but only between machines on the same physical LAN. Missing for 10: private networking across hosts or datacenters (overlay limited to the same physical LAN), deeper docs on overlay setup and management, independent or hands-on corroboration of port exposure and overlay networking.
